WITH payments_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.captured_at,
    p.amount,
    p.currency_code
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.status IN ('captured', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded')
    AND p.captured_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND p.captured_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
ledger_counts AS (
  SELECT
    le.payment_id,
    COUNT(*) AS entry_count
  FROM ledger_entries le
  WHERE le.payment_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY le.payment_id
),
payments_with_fx AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.captured_at,
    p.amount / er.rate AS amount_eur,
    COALESCE(lc.entry_count, 0) AS entry_count
  FROM payments_2025 p
  LEFT JOIN ledger_counts lc ON lc.payment_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = DATE(p.captured_at)
),
payments_with_month AS (
  SELECT
    cd.month_label,
    cd.month_start,
    pf.amount_eur,
    pf.entry_count
  FROM payments_with_fx pf
  JOIN calendar_days cd ON cd.calendar_date = DATE(pf.captured_at)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    month_label,
    month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN entry_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payments_without_ledger_entries,
    SUM(CASE WHEN entry_count = 0 THEN amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS amount_at_risk_eur
  FROM payments_with_month
  GROUP BY month_label, month_start
)
SELECT
  month_label AS month,
  total_payments,
  payments_without_ledger_entries,
  ROUND(100.0 * payments_without_ledger_entries / total_payments, 2) AS pct_without_ledger_entries,
  ROUND(amount_at_risk_eur, 2) AS amount_at_risk_eur
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_start
note: Converted payment amounts to EUR by dividing by the EUR→payment-currency exchange_rates.rate on the capture date (rate is EUR-per-1-quote-currency... actually rate is quote units per 1 EUR, so amount/rate = EUR); months with no matching payments simply won't appear (all 12 months are expected to have data in 2025).
